description: Dwarf clients: contractual, pay-focused, dry. They put terms in writing and check the fine print.

w-hail: Morning, Captain. Mind the ledger on the table.
I heard you take honest work.
Good day. Don't touch the samples.
You've the look of someone who reads the small print.
Captain. I'm {client}, and I like things in writing.
w-intro: I handle the contracts for {faction}. Mind the clauses.
I'm {client}. I've paid every debt I owe.
My family's been in {faction} longer than your ship's been in the yards.
I'm {client}. I'm told I haggle, which is a rude word for being careful.
w-frame: The job is plain and the terms are plainer.
I'll lay it out, clause by clause.
I need a job done, and done right.
It's honest, and I've written it down.
There's no tricks in it. I checked.
It's a fair piece of work.
w-clock: You have {deadline}, and the contract says so.
I've given you {deadline}. Don't spend it all.
w-clock2: I do not pay for tardiness.
I trust we understand each other.
w-stakes: Every day late costs me coin.
Others are waiting on my word.
I've promised a buyer, and I keep promises.
Late goods rot, and so do reputations.
I'm bound by my own deadlines.
A delay cuts the profit, and the profit is thin.
w-offer: The fee is {reward}. I've checked the sums twice.
You'll be paid {reward}, and not a coin less.
w-terms: Paid on completion, as the contract says.
You'll be paid, to the coin.
No hidden fees on my side.
I'll count it out in front of you.
I won't be talked down, and I won't talk you down.
w-extra: There's a bonus if it's clean.
A bonus applies if the goods are sound.
You'll find we pay on time, which is rare.
w-caution: Check your hull before you go.
Watch for others who'd like a cut.
If it feels wrong, it is.
w-caution2: A good tool breaks when it's mishandled.
You're not the first I've told.
w-conseq: Break the terms and the fee goes with them.
Damage is on your account, not mine.
I don't pay for broken goods.
If you lose it, you owe it.
If it goes wrong, the contract says who pays.
Don't expect an inch of slack beyond the clauses.
w-part: Don't make me chase the fee, or the goods.
Do it right and we'll deal again.
Stone doesn't lie, and neither do I.
Mind the weld seams on your way out.
